statement: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_label_roles_20260612 AS WITH train_stats AS (SELECT * FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_label_stats_20260612 WHERE split = 'train'), learned_edges AS (SELECT * FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_inferred_edges_20260612 WHERE edge_strength IN ('strong_empirical_parent', 'moderate_empirical_parent')), parent_counts AS (SELECT parent_label AS topic_category, COUNT(*) AS n_learned_children, SUM(CASE WHEN edge_strength = 'strong_empirical_parent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_strong_children, SUM(CASE WHEN edge_strength = 'moderate_empirical_parent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_moderate_children, SUM(train_n_child) AS n_train_child_instances_implied FROM learned_edges GROUP BY parent_label), child_counts AS (SELECT child_label AS topic_category, COUNT(*) AS n_learned_parents, SUM(CASE WHEN edge_strength = 'strong_empirical_parent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_strong_parents, SUM(CASE WHEN edge_strength = 'moderate_empirical_parent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_moderate_parents FROM learned_edges GROUP BY child_label) SELECT s.topic_category, s.n_label_channels AS train_n_label_channels, s.pct_nonempty_channels AS train_pct_nonempty_channels, s.pct_label_instances_first AS train_pct_label_instances_first, s.avg_zero_based_position AS train_avg_zero_based_position, coalesce(p.n_learned_children, 0) AS n_learned_children, coalesce(p.n_strong_children, 0) AS n_strong_children, coalesce(p.n_moderate_children, 0) AS n_moderate_children, coalesce(p.n_train_child_instances_implied, 0) AS n_train_child_instances_implied, coalesce(c.n_learned_parents, 0) AS n_learned_parents, coalesce(c.n_strong_parents, 0) AS n_strong_parents, coalesce(c.n_moderate_parents, 0) AS n_moderate_parents, CASE WHEN coalesce(p.n_learned_children, 0) >= 3 AND coalesce(c.n_learned_parents, 0) = 0 THEN 'empirical_parent' WHEN coalesce(p.n_learned_children, 0) >= 1 AND coalesce(c.n_learned_parents, 0) > 0 THEN 'intermediate_or_crosscutting_parent' WHEN coalesce(c.n_learned_parents, 0) > 0 THEN 'empirical_child' ELSE 'standalone_or_sparse' END AS empirical_role FROM train_stats s LEFT JOIN parent_counts p ON s.topic_category = p.topic_category LEFT JOIN child_counts c ON s.topic_category = c.topic_category
